---
title: smalldocs 0.5.0
subtitle: A Markdown copy of each page, for agents
date: 2026-10-21
author: Rahul Dave
categories: [release]
image: ../images/mark.svg
---

A site can now write a Markdown copy of each page, and an index of the copies, `llms.txt`. A language
model or a coding agent reads the copies more easily than the HTML pages.

Set `llms-txt: true` under `website`, in `_smalldocs.yml` or in `_quarto.yml`. smalldocs then writes
`page.llms.md` beside each `page.html`, and `llms.txt` at the top of the site. It uses the option and the
file names of Quarto 1.9.

This site turns it on. Read its index, [llms.txt](/llms.txt), or the copy of a page, such as
[Writing pages](../guide/markdown.llms.md). [Pages for agents](../guide/llms.qmd) says what a copy holds.

A site that does not set the option builds as before. The option changes no HTML page.
